no_dashboard.title: Welcome to CooProg!
no_dashboard.description:
As a {{role}}, you don't have a personal planning dashboard since this feature is specifically designed for artistic teams and venues to manage their projects and tours.

Don't worry though! You can still:
- Browse and discover all projects in the community
- View detailed information about each project
- Follow the progress of tours and performances

Use the menu above to explore all the features available to you!

artistic_team.title: Welcome to your dashboard!
artistic_team.description:
Your show will appear on the dashboard as soon as a venue sets the first date (confirmed or in option) of a first tour project.

**Once this first date is set, the tour is launched!**
Indicate all the dates of the tour, your desired programming periods, share the project's evolutions in the chat and complete all the information necessary for its organization.
artistic_team.create_project: Search or create a show on CooProg
artistic_team.create_project_explanation: Check if your show is already on CooProg or create it by clicking the button above!
